report.answer: The dual-rail (E2) three-way intersection is the MCP config surface: mcp-json-mcpservers, mcp-remote-http, mcp-stdio. That is the citable portable core. Workspace rules, AGENTS.md, global rules and skills appear in all three vendors' documentation (["agents-md", "global-rules", "mcp-json-mcpservers", "mcp-remote-http", "mcp-stdio", "skills", "workspace-rules"]) but Windsurf lacks a public structured source rail, so those cells are E3 and are not cited as measured fact. The advertised union is larger: Roo custom-modes and mode-specific-rules, Cline hooks / Memory Bank methodology / cross-vendor rule import, and Windsurf first-class memories. An adapter that targets the union will not be portable. SUCCESS:RES-0031 in the receipt AND a printed three-way intersection plus the three unique-feature sets it was derived from
